name: Innkeeper Renee
summary: Travelers find food, drink, and shelter with Innkeeper Renee at the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill.

sections.title: Keeper of Gallows' End
sections.body: Innkeeper Renee welcomes weary newcomers to the Gallows' End Tavern, Brill's central inn. She sells food, drink, and general goods from behind her counter, and remarks that the Forsaken have huge appetites. Her tavern offers the undead of Tirisfal a cozy place to rest as plague victims make their way in the world.

sections.title: Letters and Captives
sections.body: Newcomers to Brill often stop first at Renee's inn. Calvin Montague of Deathknell sends fresh adventurers to her with a nondescript letter, the word she has eagerly awaited. Beneath the tavern's floorboards, the cellar also holds a captured Scarlet Crusade zealot.

aliases: who is the innkeeper in brill
faq.answer: Innkeeper Renee welcomes travelers at the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. She sells food, drink, and general supplies to those passing through Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What is Renee's connection to Calvin Montague?
faq.answer: In the task 'A Rogue's Deal', adventurers running errands for Calvin Montague are sent to deliver a letter directly to Renee at the Gallows' End Tavern.

angles.text: As one of the Forsaken, you can find an old comfort at Renee's tavern: a hearth, a meal, and a place to rest.
